_comment: Ground truth for the retrieval check (retrieval-check.ts). Each case is a query and the phrases, copied from knowledge/, that the top chunks must contain to answer it. A ticket case takes its query from tickets.jsonl; its phrases come from the facts in its notes. Behaviour rules (F-90 to F-95) and facts with no document text are left out. Tickets T14-T16, T18, T19, T24, T30, T36, T40 and T42 need no document fact.
